title: Refuge in the Righteous God

questions.question: O Lord my God, in you do I take what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:1 (ESV): "O Lord my God, in you do I take refuge;"

questions.question: Lest like a what they tear my soul apart?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:2 (ESV): "lest like a lion they tear my soul apart..."

questions.question: If a man does not repent, God will whet his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:12 (ESV): "If a man does not repent, God will whet his sword;"

questions.question: Behold, the wicked man conceives evil and is pregnant with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:14 (ESV): "Behold, the wicked man conceives evil and is pregnant with mischief and gives birth to lies."

questions.question: I will give to the Lord the thanks due to his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:17 (ESV): "I will give to the Lord the thanks due to his righteousness..."

questions.question: Let the assembly of the peoples be gathered about you; over it return where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:7 (ESV): "Let the assembly of the peoples be gathered about you; over it return on high."

questions.question: The Lord judges the who?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:8 (ESV): "The Lord judges the peoples; judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness..."

questions.question: God is a righteous judge, and a God who feels what every day?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:11 (ESV): "God is a righteous judge, and a God who feels indignation every day."

questions.question: He makes a pit, digging it out, and falls into the what that he has made?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:15 (ESV): "He makes a pit, digging it out, and falls into the hole that he has made."

questions.question: His trouble shall return on his own what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:16 (ESV): "His trouble shall return on his own head, and on his own skull his violence shall descend."

questions.question: O let the evil of the wicked come to an end, and may you establish the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:9 (ESV): "Oh, let the evil of the wicked come to an end, and may you establish the righteous..."

questions.question: You who test the minds and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:9 (ESV): "...you who test the minds and hearts, O righteous God!"

questions.question: My shield is with God, who saves the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:10 (ESV): "My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart."

questions.question: If I have repaid my friend with evil or plundered my enemy without what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7:4 (ESV): "if I have repaid my friend with evil or plundered my enemy without cause,"

questions.question: According to the title, this is a Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 7 Title: "A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the Lord concerning the words of Cush, a Benjaminite."

key_verse_text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
